name: VA-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Long-serving incumbent Bobby Scott running for reelection
Republican challenger raised only about $6,600 with minimal cash
Prediction markets price Democratic win at roughly 96%
model.rationale: Bobby Scott holds a heavily Democratic Hampton Roads district, is a well-established incumbent, and faces a Republican who has raised almost nothing, while markets price the race as near-certain Democratic. The fundamentals point to a comfortable double-digit win.
model.watch: A surprise wave-level Republican environment or an unexpected independent candidacy drawing unusual support could narrow the margin, though not plausibly enough to threaten the seat.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Bobby Scott has represented this southeastern Virginia district for decades, and the seat remains firmly Democratic with an 18-point partisan lean. He is running again after easily securing renomination.

His Republican opponent, Edwin Rivera, has raised only a few thousand dollars and has minimal cash on hand, with no outside spending reported. Independent candidates on the ballot lack the resources to be competitive. Prediction markets give Scott roughly a 96% chance of winning, and no expert raters flag the race as contested. All available evidence points to a safe Democratic hold with a margin in the low-to-mid twenties.
